recommendation: Keep the source correction as-is. It is a narrow completion of the published FHIR-18407 resolution; broader narrative authoring guidance would require a separate work-group decision.
issue_request: FHIR-18407 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I issue for R5. It asked whether the specification should set rules for narrative after observing that DomainResource narrative definitions said resource definitions may define clinically safe narrative content, and the final resolution was to note in ImplementationGuide that IGs may provide guidance about what should be included in narrative.
initial_application: The issue was applied by historical commit e74e3bc65e9afeaf98a9ab002ca8c94710278077, which added a Roles of Implementation Guides section to source/implementationguide/implementationguide-notes.xml. The added bullet for narrative said 'user of the narrative in the resources', so the intended guidance about narrative content was present in the right area but ambiguously worded.
additional_context: ImplementationGuide is active in source/fhir.ini and the edited notes file feeds the current resource narrative. The general Narrative page and DomainResource structure definition already retain the base rule that resource definitions/profiles may specify clinically safe narrative content. Bounded Jira, Zulip, and Confluence searches found no later or conflicting community decision for FHIR-18407.
reconciliation: Changed source/implementationguide/implementationguide-notes.xml to say implementation guides often detail additional rules about what content should be included in resource narratives.
source_changes: source/implementationguide/implementationguide-notes.xml: clarified the narrative bullet in the active ImplementationGuide notes from ambiguous 'user of the narrative' wording to explicit guidance about what content should be included in resource narratives.
